target.title: [codex] Fix Claude keychain prompt toggle
target.body:
## Summary

- Migrate legacy Claude `securityCLIExperimental` keychain read preferences back to the Security.framework reader.
- Make **Avoid Keychain prompts** control the Claude OAuth prompt policy (`never`) instead of selecting `/usr/bin/security`.
- Keep the Claude Keychain prompt policy visible and update the setting copy to describe prompt prevention.
- Add focused settings/provider descriptor coverage and document the fix in the changelog.

Fixes #1877.

## Root Cause

The **Avoid Keychain prompts** toggle selected the experimental `/usr/bin/security find-generic-password -w` reader. That CLI path can still trigger macOS Keychain prompts, so enabling the no-prompt setting inverted the expected behavior. The standard Security.framework path is the one where CodexBar can apply its no-UI policy.

## Validation

- `swift test --filter SettingsStoreCoverageTests`
- `swift test --filter ProviderSettingsDescriptorTests`
- `make check`
- `git diff --check`

`make test` was started but intentionally interrupted after a macOS Keychain prompt appeared. Per `AGENTS.md`, full-suite validation paths that can display Keychain prompts should not be used for this change; coverage here is through focused parser/settings/provider tests and lint/checks.
